src/pinboard/mcp/initiative_operations.py: initiative request decoding and rejection projection
identity.rationale: Required independent native boundary shapes: consolidation decodes its own preview/confirm Envelope and emits consolidation-specific DecisionFailureCode, recovery and correct-input/refresh-action results; initiative decodes its distinct operation union and emits initiative RejectionCode, recovery and correct-input results. The shared algorithm already belongs to msgspec.convert. Further sharing would parameterize or couple independently owned schemas and rejection decisions without giving one product decision a clearer owner. Retain the typed local producers and decoders. This judgment is falsified if both boundaries actually acquire one accepted request family and the same rejection/recovery/retry contract; current concrete Envelope and Rejected declarations show that they differ. Recompute exact matched occurrences and direct residue after source changes; this record applies only to the independently reviewed pair, not another occurrence or a future protocol change.
